title: Congrats to the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 4: Ghost in the Machine Winners!
excerpt: The results are in for the final week of our Hacktoberfest DEV Challenges! For Ghost in the Machine,...
content_html:
Digital ofrendas and dead code séances won

The results are in for the final week of our Hacktoberfest DEV Challenges! For Ghost in the Machine, we asked you to build something spooky, or something that honors the past in the spirit of Día de los Muertos, with open-weight models or open-source AI.

You took the theme in every direction we hoped for, and plenty we didn't see coming. We saw digital ofrendas, ghosts of forgotten repos, and séances for dead code. Many of you showed exactly why open innovation matters here: family stories, inboxes, and photos that never leave your own machine.

Thank you for your patience while we reviewed every submission, and thank you to everyone who built with us this week and all month long. Now, let's celebrate our winners!

🎉 Congratulations To…

Featured Category Winners

Partner Category Winners

Prizes

  • Overall winner: $250 USD, a DEV++ membership, and an exclusive DEV badge
  • Featured category winners: $200 USD and an exclusive DEV badge each
  • Partner category winners: $100 USD and an exclusive DEV badge each

All participants with a valid submission will receive a completion badge.

A huge thank you to our partners for making these prizes possible, this week and all month long!

That's a Wrap on Hacktoberfest 2026

Five challenges, five themes, and more open-source AI projects than we ever imagined. Thank you to every builder, partner and community member who showed up week after week. You made this the biggest Hacktoberfest on DEV yet.

What's Next?

The fun doesn't stop here! The Presage SmartSpectra SDK Challenge is live now through November 22, with $3,000 in prizes across ten winners:

Happy coding, and see you next Hacktoberfest! 👻🌼
